corrections.proposed: removed after 1974 and before 1986; exact year unknown
corrections.why: Register gives the removal window as 'After 1974 before 1986'. 1986 is the Thornton Survey date, which bounds the removal from above; it is not a removal year.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register's location block gives 3,671 ft (1,119 m), which matches the brief's elevation. The description line gives 3,698' for the Groveland Ranger District. The story gives no elevation.

notes_for_editor: Only the FFLOS register page has content. The Forest Lookouts page for Jones Point (californialookouts.weebly.com/jones-point.html) shows a header and 'Removed' with no history text, so it is not cited. Two WebSearch calls found nothing on this site. The register also lists a 2011 photo caption (courtesy peakbagging.com) whose image was not read; it may show what is at the site now, so check it before writing any 'today' line. A search snippet mentioned a 1993 Thornton CDF lookout inventory on tDAR, not read and not verified to cover Jones Point. Photo captions only, no image URLs, so no photos entries.
